name: Smells Like Queer Spirit
description: Smells Like Queer Spirit is an 18+ DJ set party at Bar of Soap in Porto.
longDescription:
Smells Like Queer Spirit is a DJ set and party scheduled for 13 November 2026 at Bar of Soap, located at Rua do Bolhão 132 in Porto.

The event begins at 22:00 and is restricted to attendees aged 18 and over.
